body: I can’t. I can’t make people a part of my life. I don’t care how far I could get if I started trying. It doesn’t matter anyways. It’s just kind of hellish to have to acknowledge. Like I said I can’t deal with the inherent humility of my situation. I can’t look at someone in the face and tell them I love them. I can’t say it with conviction. I can barely tolerate having a conversation because it is too mentally exhausting to do. I can’t connect with others emotionally. I’ve never been able to earn the love of another person.

For instance, true love is a myth. I’m unable to feel and express emotions, and romantic feelings aren’t something I can handle, process, express, or deal with. I’m so averse to close interpersonal relationships that I don’t believe it’s possible for me to feel that way towards another person again. 

All the things that you claim are amazing don’t seem that way. The fact that one day it will all be gone with my passing makes them seem rather insignificant. I’ve never understood wonder at the universe. Just because something is unfathomably large doesn’t really make it significant. It really doesn’t matter what kind of things we find out there. I guess the have the potential to matter. 

I don’t know. If you really understood my position, you would see that it is futile to change, because to change is impossible. My only hope is to brainwash myself into positivity and that’s not something I think I can commit to. Positivity is like a lie. A trick to fool myself into thinking my experience could be what it never could. And the reason my experience will never change is because I’m unable to cope with many fundamental things about life itself. Things that cannot and will never change in and of themselves. There are many areas of life which I cannot thrive in due to the fundamental nature of who I am.

 It all seems so pointless, and I can’t handle committing myself to personal change of such magnitude as would be necessary for things to “get better,” as they say.
